(actor root (clock clk) (reset rst_n) (interface (input start) (input incoming (width 3)) (output first_done) (output second_done) (output parent_done)) (imports (library common.worker as lib)) (use lib.worker as first (bind (clock clk) (reset rst_n) (input start start)  (output done first_done))) (use lib.worker as second (bind (clock clk) (reset rst_n) (input start start)  (output done second_done))) (transaction parent (ports (input delay (width 4))) (on start) (wait delay) (complete parent_done)))
(library common.worker (exports (actor worker)) (actor worker (clock clk) (reset rst_n) (interface (input start)  (output done)) (transaction main (ports (input payload (width 3))) (on start) (set payload 1) (wait payload) (complete done))))
